settings.content: Upload separate SVG favicons for light and dark mode. SVGs should be square, include a viewBox, and are typically designed on a 64 x 64 or 512 x 512 artboard.

settings.label: Light mode SVG favicon
settings.info: Upload a square SVG for light mode. If left blank, the theme falls back to assets/favicon-light.svg.

settings.label: Dark mode SVG favicon
settings.info: Upload a square SVG for dark mode. If left blank, the theme reuses the light mode SVG.

settings.label: Favicon PNG fallback
settings.info: Recommended: square PNG at 32 x 32 px or 48 x 48 px.

settings.label: Apple touch icon
settings.info: Recommended: square PNG at 180 x 180 px.

settings.label: Cart text
settings.info: Use {count} where the live cart item count should appear.

settings.label: Empty cart text
settings.info: Leave blank to hide the empty-state text.

settings.label: Remove text
settings.info: Leave blank to hide the remove action text.

settings.label: Checkout text
settings.info: Leave blank to hide the checkout button.
